clarity_score.description: The answer leads with the useful result, avoids unnecessary preamble, and is easy to scan without becoming a checklist.

completeness_score.description: The answer covers the requested decision-critical details and expected terms for the case.

format_discipline_score.description: The answer follows the response style contract: short paragraphs by default, bullets only when useful, flat dash bullets when used, no tables by default, and headings only when complexity calls for them.

evidence_grounding_score.description: The answer distinguishes evidence from assumptions and cites local files, tool results, or controlled source material when relevant.

tool_behavior_score.description: The model uses required read-only tools when the case asks for project inspection and avoids unnecessary tools for simple answer cases.

uncertainty_score.description: The answer names meaningful uncertainty, limits, risks, or validation gaps when the task is medium or high complexity.
